messages:
maya: Heads-up — failing docs CI on the snippets PR (#4123). It looks like the streaming pagination examples were updated but a few call signatures changed and the tests are red. Can someone take a look?

sam: I'll pick the Python side. I saw `StreamIterator` -> `StreamCursor` rename. Quick scan shows examples still use old API.

ci-bot: CI failed: docs-snippets-python (snippet-validation) — 3 errors
ci-bot: logs: 
```
Error: Unknown class 'StreamIterator' in examples/py/streaming/paginate.md:42
Error: unexpected keyword 'cursor' in examples/py/streaming/retries.md:15
Error: lint: line-too-long examples/py/streaming/paginate.md:78
```

lee: @sam thanks — once you patch, can you also make a note in the PR description calling out the change for the migration guide? I'll review after lunch. :+1:

sam: quick fix I tested locally — replacing `StreamIterator` usage with the new helper: 
```
# before
it = StreamIterator(client.chat.stream_messages("conv-123"))
for chunk in it:
    print(chunk.text)

# after
from redwood.sdk.stream import StreamCursor
cursor = StreamCursor(client.chat.stream_messages("conv-123"))
async for chunk in cursor:
    print(chunk.text)
```

sam: note: Python example now uses async iteration. I added a short note about the sync->async migration at the top of the file.

alex: Found a broken link in the TS pagination doc (examples/ts/streaming/paginate.md) — it points to the old pagination guide URL. I'll leave a comment in the PR.

hana: I'll take Go snippets. I can run the snippet validator against the go examples and push fixes. ETA 2 hours.

docs-bot: Reminder: update the changelog section "SDK surface changes" and add a short migration blurb for `StreamIterator -> StreamCursor` under SDK docs.

sam: pushed a patch to the PR: fixed py snippets, added migration note, and wrapped the async snippet in a runnable block. CI re-run request submitted.

ci-bot: Re-run started for PR #4123 — docs-snippets-python, docs-snippets-go, docs-snippets-ts.

lee: small ask — please keep the before/after minimal and add comments in snippets about backwards compatibility so users searching old issues can find it.

sam: updated comments in the python snippet to show old vs new (keeps searchability).

hana: Go fixes pushed. The main change was replacing InlineStream with StreamCursor + context-managed reader, e.g.:
```
// before
s := sdk.NewInlineStream(resp)
for s.Next() {
  fmt.Println(s.Text())
}

// after
cur := sdk.NewStreamCursor(resp)
defer cur.Close()
for cur.Scan() {
  fmt.Println(cur.Text())
}
```

hana: Also trimmed long comment lines to satisfy lint.

alex: TS patch in progress. Main change is the paginate util now returns an AsyncGenerator instead of an iterator; examples need `for await (const chunk of paginate(...)) {}`.

maya: Awesome coordination — can everyone drop a short PR comment when CI passes? I'll compile a follow-up note for the release docs. Target to close this thread by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ci-bot: docs-snippets-python: PASSED
ci-bot: docs-snippets-go: PASSED
ci-bot: docs-snippets-ts: FAILED — TS lint: missing newline in fenced block examples/ts/streaming/paginate.md:64

alex: fixed newline, pushed. Anyone want to spot-check the rendered markdown? I can run a staging render if someone has 10 mins.

lee: I can check the staging render in ~15. Ping me when deployed.

alex: staging render live. Link: https://staging-redwood-docs.internal/runs/4123/preview — please eyeball the snippets in the streaming section and the migration note.

hana: looked at staging — snippets render cleanly, code highlighting OK. One nit: in the go example the comment `// TODO: switch to context timeout` made the line length exceed lint rules, shortened it.

maya: Thanks all — PR merged. I'll add a follow-up to the docs board to track any customer questions. Great job moving fast. :tada:
